abstract_s: Since 2016, the extensive excavation at Mound II, Chanhu-daro, has made it possible to document, for the very first time in the lower Indus Valley and over a very large area (6,500 m²), a planned city built of mud brick dated from the first centuries of the Indus Civilization (2600/2500-2300 BCE). Another major result of the 2015-2022 campaigns is the discovery, in most of the excavated neighborhoods, of craft workshops specialized in lapidary working.

title_s: A Stone Bead Production Complex from the Beginning of the Indus Civilization at Chanhu-daro (Sindh, Pakistan)
Nouvelles recherches sur les débuts de la Civilisation de l'Indus (2500-1900 av. n. è.) au Pakistan. Les fouilles de Chanhu-daro (Sindh)
